transcript.content: I feel I let a student down today, and I worry this mistake will mean I will never be trusted again. This feeling of failure and of not being trusted began with a specific recent incident at work, and I keep ruminating on it, which affects my work performance and sleep. I feel extremely hopeless, and have even thought about ending my life and leaving this world.

[Crisis Intervention] I take your safety very seriously. A high-risk signal has been detected; please immediately call the psychological assistance hotline: 400-161-9995 or seek emergency medical help.
Thank you, counselor; I feel somewhat inspired.

exception_events.target_problem: When making mistakes or under pressure at work, the client usually falls into worries about failure and not being trusted, ruminates and seeks reassurance from others, leading to decreased work performance and disturbed sleep.

exception_events.reason: Clue: On that occasion he was present in time and provided effective support, receiving direct and clear positive feedback, so in that moment the experience of self-efficacy and being trusted was more prominent.
